I localized the issue but did not edit project source or tests: this run’s repository instructions restrict me to fault localization. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

In [report/util.go](/app/report/util.go:523), `diff` rebuilds `Packages` only from the current scan. `getDiffCves` iterates only current CVEs, so it cannot return resolved CVEs; it also includes CVEs whose metadata changed even when they appear in both scans. [models/vulninfos.go](/app/models/vulninfos.go:11) has no diff status field, constants, or requested formatting and counting methods. The existing [diff test](/app/report/util_test.go:177) covers unchanged and newly detected CVEs, but does not assert status or removals.

The fix should classify CVEs by membership in the two scans, apply the plus/minus selections, attach status to each returned entry, and source each affected package from the scan that supplied that entry. One behavior remains unspecified: how a server with no previous scan should be reported.

Diff reports now mark newly detected CVEs with `+` and resolved CVEs with `-`. The `-diff-plus` and `-diff-minus` flags let users include either type or both. Diff entries use package details from the scan that supplied each CVE, and text, CSV, and TUI reports show the status prefix.

Added the requested `DiffStatus`, `CveIDDiffFormat`, and `CountDiff` interfaces. `go test ./report ./models ./subcmds` and `git diff --check` pass.

VERDICT: FIX

The applied patch has two code defects:

- [report/util.go](/app/report/util.go:540) stores current and previous package versions in one map keyed by package name. If a new CVE and a resolved CVE affect the same package, one version overwrites the other. Preserve package data for each CVE’s scan source.
- [Slack](/app/report/slack.go:209), [Telegram](/app/report/telegram.go:35), [Chatwork](/app/report/chatwork.go:36), and [Syslog](/app/report/syslog.go:61) output CVEs without their diff status. Include `+` or `-` in those reports.

Tests: `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./models ./report ./subcmds` exited 0. `models` and `report` passed; `subcmds` has no test files. No TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM.

Fixed the two reviewed defects. Each diff CVE now retains package versions from its own scan, even when a new and a resolved CVE share a package name. Slack, Telegram, Chatwork, and Syslog now show `+` or `-` with diff CVE IDs. Added regression tests for the package collision and report prefixes.

The reviewer’s exact command, `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./models ./report ./subcmds`, passed. `git diff --check` passed.
